appearances.title: IST DASLab publishes GSQ-RCO GGUFs of Inkling 2 Mini: the 26B looped MoE in about 10.5 GB at 3.5 bits per weight, retaining 99% of base scores
appearances.summary: Non-uniform GGUF quants of Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini at 2.75 to 3.5 bits per weight, with per-tensor precision picked by a gradient-based search, so the 26B looped MoE fits a 12 GB GPU in llama.cpp. The card reports AIME25, GPQA-Diamond and LiveCodeBench v6 against the base model.

appearances.newly_possible: Local users can now run the 26B looped MoE Inkling 2 Mini on a 12 GB GPU in llama.cpp at 3.5 bits per weight while retaining 99% of base scores.
appearances.why: Gradient-searched non-uniform quantization makes a 26B MoE fit mainstream 12 GB cards without losing benchmark quality.
appearances.limits: Retention claims come from the model card across AIME25, GPQA-Diamond, and LiveCodeBench v6, not independent production tests.
